roots.origin: 拉丁语 capere（抓取、拿住、接收）
roots.core_concept: to grasp, to take hold and receive / 一把抓住、接过来
roots.core_image: 手探出去，把飞来的球一把接住握住
roots.english_definition: to take, to grasp, to receive

roots.core_concept: to see, to look / 看、看见
roots.core_image: 目光落在某处，把那东西看进眼里

roots.core_concept: to cut, to strike off / 切、砍、斩断
roots.core_image: 一刀落下，把整块东西齐齐切开

concepts.concept: to grasp and take in, holding what comes
concepts.core_image: 伸手一把接住飞来的球

concepts.concept: to see and take in with the eyes
concepts.core_image: 目光落定，把那物看进眼里
一刀落下，整块齐齐切开

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 朝向）+ cept（抓取）+ -able（可…的）→ 能接过来、收得下的 → 可接受的
words.origin: 拉丁语 acceptabilis：ad-（朝向）+ capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: good enough to be accepted or agreed to
words.core_concept: fit to be taken in without complaint – 值得收下、不会皱眉的
words.core_image: 对方开出的条件摆到桌上，掂量一番觉得能收下就点头
examples: The offer is acceptable to both sides.
words.recall_hint: ac-（朝向）+ cept（抓取）+ -able → 收得下的

words.root_logic: ac-（朝向）+ cept（抓取）+ -ance（名词）→ 接过来的动作或状态 → 接受
words.origin: accept 的名词：ad-（朝向）+ capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: the act of taking something offered; approval
words.core_concept: taking what is offered into one's hand – 把递过来的东西接住
words.core_image: 老师傅看了一眼递来的方案，点点头接了过去
examples: Her acceptance of the job delighted us.
words.recall_hint: ac-（朝向）+ cept（抓取）+ -ance → 接过来

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ cept（抓取）+ -ion → 从整体里被抓出去的那一项 → 例外
words.origin: 拉丁语 exceptio：ex-（向外）+ capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: something that does not follow the usual rule
words.core_concept: the item taken out from the whole – 从整体里被抓出来单独放的一项
words.core_image: 全班都穿了校服，独独有个人没穿，那份不同就是它
semantic_expansions: 例外：被抓出去单放的一项
words.recall_hint: ex-（向外）+ cept（抓取）+ -ion → 被抓出的例外

words.root_logic: exception（例外）+ -al → 超出常例的 → 杰出的/异常的
words.native_definition: unusually good; out of the ordinary
words.core_concept: standing outside the common run – 立在常例之外、超出寻常
words.core_image: 别人都画三小时，她半小时就完成还最精致，明显不在一个水平线上

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ cept（抓取）+ -ion → 把来客接过来的动作 → 接待；接受到的信息
words.origin: 拉丁语 receptio：re-（往回）+ capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: the act of welcoming someone; the way a signal is received
words.core_concept: taking the arriving one in – 把到来的人(物)接进来
words.core_image: 酒店前台，来人一进门先被接住、办入住，行李也在这里被安顿
words.recall_hint: re-（往回）+ cept（抓取）+ -ion → 把来客接过来

words.root_logic: en-（使）+ vis（看）+ -age → 使它在眼前显现 → 设想
words.origin: 法语 envisager：en-（在内）+ visage（面容）← visio ← videre（看）
words.native_definition: to imagine or picture something as likely to happen
words.core_concept: seeing it take shape before the eyes – 在眼前把它看成形
words.core_image: 脑子里已经把那座桥建起来的样子放了一遍，连桥上走车的画面都有
examples: The plan envisages a new library.
semantic_expansions: 设想/展望：在眼前把将来看成形
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ vis（看）+ -age → 在眼前显现 → 设想

words.root_logic: pre-（预先）+ cis（切）→ 预先切定、分毫不差的 → 精确的
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecisus：prae-（预先）+ caedere（切）——'预先切定'
words.native_definition: exact and accurate, with no error
words.core_concept: cut in advance to the exact mark – 预先切到那条准线上
words.core_image: 木匠在木料上先画好线，下刀正落线心，不偏一丝
words.recall_hint: pre-（预先）+ cis（切）→ 切到准线 → 精确
